# Sources

This folder holds the provenance records for the original PDF documents ingested into the wiki. Each page acts as a source manifest for a specific DANIBD (Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases) annual report, documenting the file path, SHA-256 hash, total page count, and ingestion timestamp. These records also catalog the individual extracted document pages and log any text extraction warnings encountered during processing.

## Pages

- [[danibd-2023|Source: DANIBD_2023.pdf]] — Provenance manifest for the 29-page 2023 DANIBD report, including extraction warnings for empty text on the final page.
- [[danibd-2024|Source: DANIBD_2024.pdf]] — Provenance manifest for the 47-page 2024 DANIBD report, noting extraction warnings for empty text on pages 4 and 47.
